title: The Key to the Universe (Forgotten Books Edition)
author: Harriette and F. Homer Curtiss
description: A second copy of The Key to the Universe by Harriette and F. Homer Curtiss, here in the Forgotten Books reprint edition of the 1915 work of the Order of the Christian Mystics. It offers the same text: a spiritual interpretation of the numbers 0 to 10, treating each as a key to cosmic law and to the disciple's path of initiation, with geometric symbols, astrological, Kabbalistic and Tarot correspondences, and Christian mystical teaching. It is kept as an alternative scan of the same book; readers may prefer whichever copy has the clearer text.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
